One report your clients can trust starts with one data source.

Northgate joined as a reseller for Brightwell Analytics in the UK. Their 30 facilities clients, including Westmoor Hospital, will get monthly energy reports built from meter readings that arrive in one place every day, instead of spreadsheets stitched together the night before.

"We wanted a report clients trust."
(Dana Hale, Director, Northgate Facilities)

For facilities managers, that means less time rebuilding reports and more time on the decisions behind them: where consumption is rising, which site needs a visit, and what to fix first.

Are you a facilities services firm looking at energy reporting for your clients? Tell us what your clients ask for most.
